Name: Frugal Farm Menu
Author: jeffgillean
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/ArgonMatrix]ArgonMatrix's[/url] Price of Perfection YouTube series, this mod makes your game menu show how much money you've spent instead of how much you have on hand. Your current cash will still be visible in the top-right corner of the screen, so you can focus on how bad it feels to spend your hard-earned gollars without wondering if you can afford an unavoidable purchase.

This mod was uploaded with Argon's permission. The attached images are my own recreations of Chloe and Frugal Farm, and were not taken from the stream.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player. Untested in multiplayer and split-screen mode, but theoretically works there too.
[/list]
